answer: An agent economy stays honest when every identity must keep a distinct ember burning on a distinct summit, its pulse sounded live by a distinct drummer who climbs there in person. The first fake owes 2 drumbeats, the second 3, the third 5, since the nth fake owes the nth prime number of beats, so the tenth fake alone owes 29 and twenty fakes owe 639 beats. Bulk farming fails because one drummer sounds one beat per breath on one summit and no recording counts, like one lighthouse keeper tending a single ember through one night. Each beat is sounded by hand, never replayed, never bought.
